sales_data.transaction_id: Unique transaction identifier (TXN/RET prefix); 4.3% null rate indicates data quality issue
sales_data.transaction_date: Transaction date in mixed format (MM/DD/YYYY and YYYY-MM-DD); 116 distinct dates across ~5 months
sales_data.store_id: Foreign key reference to stores table; 2.69% null rate; 10 distinct stores (S01-S10)
sales_data.product_id: Unique product identifier; 20 distinct products; no nulls
sales_data.product_name: Descriptive product name; 20 products across Electronics, Sport, Home & Kitchen categories
sales_data.category: Product category classification; 21 unique values suggest data quality issue (category/product mismatch)
sales_data.quantity: Transaction quantity sold; ranges -4 to +8 (negative indicates returns/adjustments); mean 3.94
sales_data.unit_price: Price per unit; ranges $0.01 to $9,999.99; mean $356.27 (high variance suggests diverse product mix)
sales_data.total_amount: Transaction total amount (quantity × unit_price); ranges -$1,230.56 to +$9,999.99 (negatives for returns)
sales_data.customer_segment: Customer classification; 16 unique values (Loyal, Premium, etc.); categorical dimension
sales_data.payment_method: Payment mode used; 4 distinct methods (Apple Pay, PayPal, etc.); low cardinality

stores.store_id: Unique store identifier; 10 stores; primary key; matches sales_data.store_id
stores.store_name: Descriptive store location name; 10 unique values; natural key component
stores.region: Geographic region classification; 4 distinct regions (Northeast, Southeast, etc.)
stores.city: City location; 10 distinct cities; geographic dimension
stores.state: State abbreviation; 9 distinct states; geographic dimension

join_keys.notes: Natural join key; sales_data has 10 unique store_id values matching all 10 stores in stores table. However, 5 nulls in sales_data.store_id will result in unmatched records.

quality_observations.issue: Missing values (8 records, 4.3% null rate) and lower cardinality (166 unique vs 186 rows) indicates potential duplicates or null transactions
quality_observations.recommendation: Investigate null transaction_ids before Bronze layer; may require rejection or default ID generation

quality_observations.issue: Missing values (5 records, 2.69% null rate) will cause join failures with stores table
quality_observations.recommendation: Handle nulls via left outer join or imputation strategy; document orphaned records

quality_observations.issue: Mixed date formats (MM/DD/YYYY and YYYY-MM-DD); 0% nulls but requires standardization
quality_observations.recommendation: Standardize to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format in Bronze layer; validate date range (Jan-Mar 2024)

quality_observations.issue: 21 unique categories but only 20 products suggests category-product mismatch or inconsistency
quality_observations.recommendation: Validate category-product mapping; may indicate category misspelling or orphaned categories

quality_observations.issue: Negative quantities detected (min: -4); represents returns/adjustments mixed with sales
quality_observations.recommendation: Flag returns separately; consider transaction_type indicator in Silver layer

quality_observations.issue: Negative amounts (-$1,230.56 min) and extreme outliers ($9,999.99 max); high variance (mean $1,215.24)
quality_observations.recommendation: Apply outlier detection and validation; consider amount sign and quantity correlation

quality_observations.issue: Extreme range ($0.01 to $9,999.99) with very high variance; may indicate data entry errors
quality_observations.recommendation: Flag and validate price outliers in Bronze; analyze pricing by category

quality_observations.issue: 16 unique segment values suggests high granularity or potential data quality issues (expected 3-5 typical segments)
quality_observations.recommendation: Validate segment cardinality; may indicate partial segments or data anomalies

quality_observations.issue: No quality issues detected; clean reference data with 10 stores, 4 regions, 10 cities, 9 states
quality_observations.recommendation: Can be used as-is for Bronze layer; no transformations required

sales_data.duplicate_check: transaction_id cardinality (166) < rows (186) indicates 20 potential duplicates or nulls

transformation_requirements: Handle 5 null store_ids (reject, default, or unknown store)
Handle 8 null transaction_ids (generate new IDs or reject)
Validate category-product mapping (21 categories vs 20 products)
Add transaction_type column to distinguish sales (+quantity) from returns (-quantity)
Validate unit_price and total_amount against business rules (price ranges, amount sign correlation)
Add data quality flags for records with negative amounts or anomalous quantities
